measurementNotes: Two sequential fresh sessions on one shared host with real pinned Clang DWARF, LLDB/WAMR, Chromium and strict CSP.
First-pause versus full-stack deltas measure progressive delivery within the new implementation, not a baseline speedup.
Producer pin lacks the Module instantiation hook, so this change intentionally does not inject or reuse precompiled Modules.
